purpose: Runs Squire's runner as its launchd agent does, with Claude Code under both measured profiles, to check that a server live by evidence (its process alive, and a bridge pointer naming it or a session record since its start) is kept whatever words it prints, that a server with none of that evidence after 60 seconds or whose connection drops is replaced, and that a server stopped from outside before any client is not named a fault.
title: The session kept whatever Claude Code prints

testCases.description: a server live by its bridge pointer with no session yet, or whose client left, is kept over 75 seconds, as is a connected one
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/session-live-by-evidence.test.js::a Remote Control server that prints Ready and an environment address, with a bridge pointer naming its own process and no session yet, is judged live and kept: the runner does not replace it over 75 seconds, nor a 2.1.332 server whose client made the session and then left, which prints nothing, and the eager server that prints Connected is kept too

testCases.description: a server with no evidence it is live 60 seconds after its start is replaced under both profiles
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/session-live-by-evidence.test.js::a server that has shown, 60 seconds after its start, no bridge pointer naming its own process, no session record and no connected word is replaced, under both profiles, and a pointer an earlier server left does not keep it

testCases.description: a server whose connection drops is replaced about a minute after the drop under both profiles
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/session-live-by-evidence.test.js::a server whose connection drops, a disconnection line with no connected word after it, is replaced about a minute after the drop, under both profiles (the 2.1.332 words taken to be 2.1.319's)

testCases.description: a live server stopped from outside before any client is not named stopped before any session
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/session-live-by-evidence.test.js::a 2.1.332 server stopped from outside, as an update's install stops it, before any client made a session is not recorded as stopped before any session started and the health check names no fault for it; under 2.1.319 the same; a server that dies before it was ever live is still named

testCases.description: a server with only weak evidence beside it is replaced about 60 seconds after its start
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/session-live-by-evidence.test.js::a server with only weak evidence beside it, a bridge pointer naming another live process, a pointer naming its pid written before it started, a pointer that cannot be read, or a session record an earlier server left, is replaced about 60 seconds after its start
